verdict.rationale: Postman ships in-product AI. Agent Mode works on the user's requests and responses in natural language: it can fix errors, update or add tests, visualize responses and write documentation. Postbot is also available as an in-app AI assistant, though free use is capped at 50 activities per user per month and wider access requires a purchased add-on. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated insights or analytics drawn from user data (as opposed to action-oriented assistance), detail on what Postbot's suggestions cover, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
